title: 第十一章 独倚长剑凌清秋第十二章 突飞猛进
content_zh:
巨大樟树后面，周无纪侧耳听着逐渐靠近的脚步声。
在这个位置，周无纪可不敢探头去看，他也不需要探头。
凭着敏锐听觉，周无纪能听到乱兵们身上盔甲、兵刃轻微撞击声，听到他们靴子踩在沙土上的声音，甚至听得到他们呼吸声。
通过这些复杂的声音，他在脑海中勾勒出清晰的立体空间图像。
七名乱兵沿着小路向前，前四后三，第五个人呼吸最是悠长平稳，他身上的盔甲撞击声也最明显，分明穿的是全套铁片札甲。
这人的脚步声也最沉重，却又充满了力量。
很明显，第五人必然是八品暗劲武者，这才能穿戴几十斤全铁札甲还能行动自如。
也只有队长级别军官，才有这个财力穿全铁札甲。
除此之外，走在最前面和最后面的四个人，都气息沉稳步伐有力，都达到了九品层次。
周无纪通过眉心神窍隐秘吐纳天枢星力，此等星力不受日夜影响，遍布四面八方。
炁的流转，再次加强了周无纪的六感，听觉、嗅觉、触觉、视觉都被增强了数倍。
通过炁的流转，周无纪甚至“看”到了几个乱兵身上如同实质的血煞之气。
杀的生灵多了，自然就会积累煞气。
周无纪听师父说过，军中士兵大都修习血煞诀。
血煞诀可以通过杀戮获取血煞之气，用来淬炼自身。这本是赤血教的法门，改良后传入军中。
此法狠毒，短期内能让人迅速提升武功修为，但是，若没有秘法、灵药化解煞气，煞气越强死得越快死得越惨。
一小队乱兵能有如此浓重煞气，也不知杀了多少人。
正因为如此，这队乱兵的武力远超寻常士兵。
确认的一队乱兵的真实武力情况，周无纪也是信心大增。
他神窍一呼一吸，真炁流转全身后流入七星剑，人和剑通过炁紧密连接成一体。

武者只有达到六品才能凝炼气海，感应到炁的存在。
周无纪运转真炁自成一体不向外放，就算有六品武者也未必能察觉得到。
这也是道门修炼法门的高妙之处。
几个乱兵对此自然是毫无所觉，林间小路幽暗崎岖，他们穿着全套盔甲，又知道这里就是座小村子，对周围几乎没什么警惕。
前面四人大步越过大树，谁也没看到树后藏着的周无纪。
等到那个队长走过大树的时候，周无纪听着对方脚步起落，等到对方一只脚才起未落，正是重心将换未换的时候，他突然闪身而出拔剑直刺对方颈部。
对方穿着全套铁片札甲，只有颈部、面部裸露在外。
周无纪从对方左侧出剑，正好直取对方耳根下颈部血管。
这一剑动作快疾如风，来的又异常突然。进击方位又是对方的弱手侧。
这名队长眼角瞥到寒光闪耀，跟着就是尖锐尖啸贯入耳中。
队长立即知道不妙，他在战场上大都是正面厮杀，却没什么江湖经验。
好在他武功精熟，当即缩颈收胸同时向后退避。这一式白猿跳枝，取的是白猿受惊突然跃起的变化。
content_en:
Behind the huge camphor tree, Zhou Wuji listened carefully to the footsteps approaching.
In this position, Zhou Wuji didn't dare to look around, and he didn't need to look around.
With his keen hearing, Zhou Wuji could hear the slight impact of the armor and weapons on the rebel soldiers, the sound of their boots on the sand, and even their breathing.
Through these complex sounds, he sketched a clear three-dimensional spatial image in his mind.
The seven rebel soldiers moved forward along the path, four in front and three behind. The fifth man's breathing was the longest and most steady, and the clanking sound of the armor on his body was also the most obvious. He was clearly wearing a full set of iron plate armor.
This man's footsteps were also the heaviest, yet full of power.
Obviously, the fifth person must be an eighth-grade dark strength warrior, so he can wear dozens of kilograms of full-iron armor and still move freely.
Only captain-level officers have the financial resources to wear full iron armor.
In addition, the four people walking at the front and at the back all have calm auras and strong steps, and they have all reached the ninth level.
Zhou Wuji secretly breathed out the star power of Tianshu through the divine orifice between his eyebrows. This star power is not affected by day and night and spreads in all directions.
The flow of Qi once again strengthened Zhou Wuji's six senses. Hearing, smell, touch, and vision were all enhanced several times.
Through the flow of Qi, Zhou Wuji even "saw" the actual bloody evil energy on several of the rebels.
If you kill too many creatures, you will naturally accumulate evil spirits.
Zhou Wuji heard from his master that most of the soldiers in the army practiced the Blood Demon Art.
The Blood Evil Technique can obtain blood evil energy through killing and use it to temper oneself. This was originally a method of the Scarlet Blood Cult, but it was improved and introduced into the army.
This method is vicious and can allow people to quickly improve their martial arts skills in the short term. However, if there are no secret methods and elixirs to resolve the evil spirits, the stronger the evil spirits, the faster and more miserably they will die.
A small group of rebel soldiers could have such a strong evil spirit, and they killed an unknown number of people.
Because of this, the force of this group of rebel soldiers is far beyond that of ordinary soldiers.
After confirming the true force status of a group of rebel soldiers, Zhou Wuji also became more confident.
Every time he exhales and inhales from his spiritual orifice, the true energy flows through his body and then flows into the Seven Star Sword. The man and the sword are closely connected through the energy.
Only when a warrior reaches the sixth level can he condense the sea of ​​qi and sense the existence of qi.
Zhou Wuji circulates his true energy in a self-contained body and does not release it to the outside. Even a sixth-grade warrior may not be able to detect it.
This is also the sublimity of Taoist cultivation methods.
The few rebel soldiers were naturally unaware of this. The forest path was dark and rugged. They were wearing full armor and knew that this was just a small village, so they were almost not wary of their surroundings.
The four people in front strode across the big tree, but no one saw Zhou Wuji hiding behind the tree.
When the captain walked past the big tree, Zhou Wuji listened to the rise and fall of the other party's footsteps. When one of the other party's feet had just risen and not yet landed, just when the center of gravity was about to change, he suddenly stepped out and drew his sword and stabbed the other party's neck.
The opponent was wearing a full set of iron plate armor, with only his neck and face exposed.
Zhou Wuji drew his sword from the opponent's left side, hitting the blood vessels in the opponent's neck just below the ear.
This sword movement was as fast as the wind, and it came unexpectedly. The attack direction is also the opponent's weak side.
The captain saw a flash of cold light from the corner of his eye, followed by a sharp scream that penetrated his ears.
The captain immediately knew something was wrong. He had mostly fought head-on on the battlefield, but had little experience in the arena.
Fortunately, he was proficient in martial arts and immediately shrunk his neck and chest while retreating. This style of white ape leaping from a branch is based on the variation of the white ape leaping suddenly when frightened.
